Horizon Europe – WIDERA.summary: Covers the Horizon Europe area “Widening participation and strengthening the European Research Area”, in two components. Widening participation and spreading excellence works to close the R&I performance gap across the Union through Teaming, Twinning, ERA Chairs, Excellence Hubs, the Hop-on Facility and research-management capacity building. Strengthening the ERA reforms and connects the European research and innovation system itself — researcher mobility and careers, gender equality, research ethics and integrity, knowledge valorisation and open science — in support of the four priority areas of the Pact for Research and Innovation. Unlike the thematic clusters, WIDERA has no destination layer: its calls sit directly under the programme.
